qs.s: Cette petite ___ familiale produit des sabots en bois depuis trois générations.
qs.en: This small family-run factory/workshop has been producing wooden clogs for three generations.

qs.en: This old coin bears a relief barely visible, it is so worn.

qs.en: He was climbing a steep hill to admire the landscape.
